inj_report.short: Gibbs rushed 23 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns and secured four of five targets for 20 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Gibbs unsurprisingly had his work cut out for him against the Buccaneers' typically stingy run defense, but the Lions had the luxury of continuing to pound Gibbs into the line while protecting a second-half lead. Gibbs eventually broke through for a game-long 26-yard run and cashed in with one- and four-yard touchdown runs in the fourth quarter to help ice the victory. While Gibbs fell just short of his fifth 100-yard effort in the last six games, the 2023 first-round pick is up to 13 rushing touchdowns and is averaging 5.0 yards per carry heading into a Thanksgiving Day home showdown against the Bears.

inj_report.short: Burrow completed 28 of 40 passes for 300 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed twice for minus-1 yard in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The Bengals offense started slowly and was shut out altogether in the first quarter, but Burrow was able to lead his team to 10 second-quarter points partly via a 31-yard touchdown pass to Tee Higgins. The prolific signal-caller added a four-yard scoring toss to Colbie Young in the third quarter, and Burrow then helped lead Cincinnati downfield for a go-ahead Evan McPherson 56-yard field goal with 46 seconds remaining, albeit after narrowly avoiding an interception and then taking a third-down sack. Nevertheless, the Bengals came up short when Jayden Daniels led the Commanders on a five-play, 64-yard game-winning march, but Burrow finished with his fourth tally of at least 300 passing yards this season. He'll look to put his team back in the win column in a favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Smith-Njigba gathered in eight of 10 targets for 171 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 21-13 win at Las Vegas.
inj_report.long: Smith-Njigba's Week 10 performance was fueled by a 71-yard catch and run for a touchdown in the middle of the third quarter, but he still was able to put up 100 yards on his other seven receptions en route to a new season high in the category. As the Seahawks hit their Week 11 bye, he's reached the century mark in receiving eight times and resides on a 79-1,207-10 line on 109 targets through 10 contests. Smith-Njigba's next chance to continue aggravating opposing defenses arrives Sunday, Nov. 29, at San Francisco.

inj_report.short: Lawrence completed 25 of 47 passes for 301 yards with one touchdown and two interceptions and rushed three times for seven yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday. He also fumbled twice but recovered.
inj_report.long: Lawrence just managed to generate his fourth 300-yard effort of the season, but the yardage came on a season-high number of pass attempts and season-low completion percentage. The Giants' notoriously stingy pass defense frequently stymied the Jaguars' typically efficient air attack, and Lawrence threw multiple interceptions for the first time this season. Lawrence did have what seemed to be a second-half touchdown pass to Parker Washington in the back of the end zone ruled incomplete and surprisingly confirmed as such on replay, but the 2021 first overall pick will be looking to get back to his mistake-free ways in a favorable Week 12 home matchup with a Titans team he threw for a season-high 352 yards against in Week 10.

inj_report.short: Daniels completed 23 of 35 passes for 289 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and added six carries for 55 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.
inj_report.long: Daniels looked like he was on his way to a middling night during a first half in which he led the Commanders to just seven points, but the 2024 first-round pick flipped a switch in the second half, particularly in the fourth quarter. Daniels led field-goal drives of 13, 11 and five plays that netted a total of 193 yards during the final period, the last one featuring strikes of 22 and 42 yards to Antonio Williams to position Drew Stevens for a game-winning field goal. Daniels finished with his second-highest passing yardage total of the season, and he also mustered his seventh interception-free effort of the campaign. Having helped Washington to a critical victory, he'll look to carry the momentum over into a favorable Week 12 road matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Williams completed 15 of 23 passes for 181 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints. He added 11 rushing yards on four carries.
inj_report.long: The Bears' offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye, and both of Williams' TD passes came in the second quarter as he connected with D'Andre Swift on a three-yard shovel pass and Colston Loveland on a 15-yard score. Williams failed to reach 200 passing yards for the first time since Week 2, and he'll take a somewhat disappointing 10:6 TD:INT through seven games into a Week 12 clash with the Lions.

inj_report.short: Allen completed 27 of 45 passes for 304 yards, one touchdown and two interceptions in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Allen threw a four-yard touchdown pass to DJ Moore in the second quarter but got picked off twice later in the first half and had a would-be third interception nullified by a penalty on the penultimate play before halftime. Despite some sloppy play and zero rushing production from Allen, the 9-1 Bills cruised past the 1-9 Dolphins as the star QB raised his season total to 25 touchdowns (14 passing, 11 rushing). Buffalo's likely to encounter more resistance Thursday night against the 8-2 Chiefs. Allen is 5-1 against Patrick Mahomes in the regular season but 0-4 when they face off in the playoffs.

inj_report.short: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Stroud's night got off to a rocky start when a deflected pass resulted in an interception on the Texans' opening drive, but the red-hot signal-caller was near perfect from that point forward. The 2023 first-round pick went on to toss three touchdown passes for the second straight game and multiple scores for the fifth consecutive contest overall. Stroud connected with Nico Collins (42 yards), Kayshon Boutte (24 yards) and Marlin Klein (13 yards) for his trio of scoring strikes, and he'll take a sparkling 22:4 TD:INT into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: St. Brown brought in five of six targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: St. Brown set the pace for the Lions in catches while also tying for the team lead in targets, and the sure-handed receiver also recorded his eighth touchdown reception of the season on a 14-yard grab early in the second quarter that opened the scoring for either team. St. Brown's yardage total left plenty to be desired, but he's still up to a 70-792-8 line on 97 targets heading into Thursday's holiday showdown at home against the Bears.

inj_report.short: Irving rushed 18 times for 68 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of four targets for 32 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Irving worked hard all afternoon against a feisty Lions defense, and outside of his game-long 23-yard run, he scuffled to 45 yards on 17 carries. Irving worked around a hard shot to the abdomen that he sustained in the second half, and he did manage to contribute a rushing touchdown for the fourth straight game when he went in from one yard out in the latter portion of the third quarter. Irving has now equaled a career high with eight rushing touchdowns, and he's 107 yards short of his second career 1,000-yard season on the ground heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Panthers on Monday night, Nov. 30.

inj_report.short: Prescott completed 28 of 33 passes for 325 yards with four touchdowns and no interceptions and added four carries for nine yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: As the final score and Prescott's numbers indicate, the prolific passer was clicking on all cylinders right out of the gate against an overmatched Titans defense. Prescott had already helped stake the Cowboys to a 27-6 lead by halftime with eight- and 10-yard touchdown strikes to CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens, respectively. Prescott struck again through the air in the second half with an 11-yard touchdown pass to Javonte Williams before closing out his touchdown tally with a two-yard toss to Brevyn Spann-Ford with just under five minutes remaining. Prescott added his second rushing touchdown of the campaign on a two-yard run in the latter portion of the third quarter, giving him his second straight five-TD performance. Prescott is up to 3,049 passing yards and a 25:6 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day home clash with the Eagles in Week 12.

inj_report.short: Chase secured five of nine targets for 31 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The Commanders focused on keeping Chase in check after his 231-yard outburst against the Steelers in Week 10, and they executed that plan to near perfection. The superstar wideout finished with his third-lowest yardage total of the season, and his sparsest since Week 4. Chase still extended his streak of five-plus-catch efforts to six games, and he'll look to bounce back to his usual level of production in a Week 12 home matchup against a vulnerable Saints defense Sunday.

inj_report.short: Goff completed 20 of 28 passes for 279 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while adding five rushes for 12 yards in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Goff put together an efficient effort on an afternoon when he recorded completions to eight different targets. The veteran signal-caller hit Amon-Ra St. Brown (14 yards) and Jameson Williams (57 yards) for his pair of touchdown passes, and he has multiple scoring strikes in two straight. Goff boasts a sparkling 20:4 TD:INT heading into a Thanksgiving Day showdown against the Bears at Ford Field on Thursday.

inj_report.short: Skattebo rushed 14 times for 34 yards and brought in three of seven targets for 14 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: Skattebo was unsurprisingly stymied on the ground by the Jaguars' elite run defense, and he couldn't really make up for it with his work through the air. Skattebo also committed another untimely turnover, fumbling at Jacksonville's 31-yard line with just over four minutes remaining in the third quarter and New York trying to add to a 20-6 lead. The change of possession ultimately didn't lead to any Jaguars points, however, and head coach John Harbaugh showed some faith in the second-year back by affording him the opportunity to ice the upset win with three carries on the final drive. Skattebo proved up to the task by netting 13 yards on those touches to force the Jags to exhaust their timeouts, and he should continue helming the backfield in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

inj_report.long: Walker has been sidelined for the Chiefs' last two games due to a sore groin and was listed as a non-participant in Monday's practice. Though the running back appears poised to take a step forward in terms of activity Tuesday, Reid's comments suggest that Walker will likely be a limited participant. The Chiefs will wait and see how Walker responds to practice Tuesday before having a better feel for his status for Thursday's game against the Bills.

inj_report.long: Lamb's near-perfect day included his fifth 100-yard effort of the season -- including his second in the last three games -- and his ninth touchdown grab, which came from eight yards out early in the second quarter. Lamb had six double-digit-yardage catches overall on the afternoon, including his game-long 29-yard grab in the first half. Lamb crossed the 1,000-yard mark for the sixth consecutive season in the process, and he'll take an 88-1,108-9 line into a Week 12 Thanksgiving Day clash at home against the Eagles.

inj_report.short: McCaffrey rushed 12 times for 49 yards and a touchdown while catching both of his targets for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
inj_report.long: McCaffrey was relatively quiet in the lopsided win, but he extended his touchdown streak to nine games with a six-yard touchdown run in the fourth quarter. The versatile running back was much less involved as a pass catcher Sunday night after racking up 161 yards and two touchdowns through the air against the Cowboys in Week 10, and he finished with a season-low 62 scrimmage yards against the Vikings. Backup Kaelon Black had just eight rushing yards on his six carries after siphoning off at least 11 rushing attempts in each of the previous three games. McCaffrey is set to face another stout defensive front in Week 12 when the 49ers host the Seahawks, against whom McCaffrey churned out 83 scrimmage yards and a touchdown in Week 5.

inj_report.short: Jefferson caught seven of nine targets for 86 yards and lost a fumble in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: Jefferson has experienced an uptick in usage since the Vikings reacquired Kirk Cousins. The star WR has 16 catches for 160 yards on 22 targets in two games with Cousins, though Jefferson hasn't scored since Week 8. Jefferson fumbled at the end of a 25-yard catch in the third quarter, turning what would have been one of his best plays of the night into a lowlight. Another heavy dose of targets from Cousins likely awaits Jefferson in Week 12 against the Falcons.

inj_report.short: Williams rushed 18 times for 67 yards and a touchdown and brought in all three targets for 24 yards and another score in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Williams continued his highly fantasy-friendly season with his third multi-touchdown showing of the season. The veteran back first struck from one yard out to cap off the opening possession of the game, and he added his second scoring grab of 2026 on an 11-yard catch early in the third quarter. Williams has over 60 rushing yards in three straight games, and he's up to 10 rush TDs, his second double-digit tally in as many seasons, heading into Thursday's home divisional Thanksgiving clash with the Eagles.

inj_report.short: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The Falcons were down 14-3 by halftime and 21-3 doing into the final period, so Robinson's opportunities progressively dwindled due to game script. However, the star running back still averaged a solid 4.4 yards per carry and recorded his sixth rushing touchdown of the season on a three-yard run in the fourth quarter. Robinson has at least four receptions in three of the last four games, and he'll now have a Week 11 bye to rest up before a tough Week 12 road matchup against the Vikings on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Mahomes completed 27 of 39 passes for 324 yards with three touchdowns and no interceptions in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Mahomes was clicking early against the Cardinals' defense, capping off the opening possession of the game with an eight-yard touchdown toss to Travis Kelce. The prolific signal-caller went on to add a 22-yard scoring pass to Kelce shortly before the end of the first half, and he capped off his day with an 18-yarder to Xavier Worthy on which the speedy receiver raced up the right sideline and into the end zone. Mahomes now has consecutive 300-yard efforts and has accomplished the feat in three of the past four games overall, affording him plenty of momentum heading into a Week 12 showdown with Josh Allen and the Bills on Thanksgiving night.

inj_report.short: Cousins completed 26 of 38 passes for 235 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers. He also rushed once for no gain.
inj_report.long: After throwing a pick-six among his three interceptions when he faced San Francisco's defense in his final game with the Raiders in Week 9, Cousins had another interception returned for a touchdown by the 49ers in the second quarter of Sunday's loss. The Vikings took a 28-10 deficit into the halftime locker room, and Cousins was unable to orchestrate a comeback before Minnesota waved the white flag and inserted Carson Wentz for its final drive. Cousins is still strengthening his grasp on the offense two games into his reunion with the Vikings ahead of a Week 12 visit from the Falcons, with whom Cousins spent the previous two seasons.

inj_report.short: Smith completed 17 of 21 passes for 176 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers. He also rushed once for four yards.
inj_report.long: Smith didn't have a completion longer than 21 yards but kept the offense on schedule with an accurate performance. Most importantly, he stepped up in the red zone, which has been the team's Achilles' heel throughout the season. Smith threw a seven-yard touchdown pass to Breece Hall to snap the Jets' two-game touchdown drought in the second quarter, then tacked on touchdown passes of eight and 15 yards to practice-squad elevation Sterling Shepard. The veteran QB will take a 15:3 TD:INT into a Week 12 road game against the Dolphins, who defeated the Jets in Week 7 despite three touchdown passes from Smith.

inj_report.short: McCarthy completed 18 of 38 passes for 173 yards with a touchdown and no interceptions and rushed seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
inj_report.long: McCarthy had his share of trouble against an aggressive Jaguars defense, leading to a season-worst 47.4 percent completion rate. However, the emerging signal-caller avoided turnovers and connected with Malik Nabers for an eight-yard touchdown pass in the second quarter. McCarthy also provided some timely contributions with his legs, and he's averaging 5.4 yards on his 22 rush attempts to date. McCarthy connected with nine different targets overall as he continues to show good command of the offense, and he'll look to bounce back efficiency-wise in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Love completed 17 of 27 passes for 220 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
inj_report.long: The 28-year-old QB came into the game having been sacked just 17 times in his first nine games of the season, but Minnesota brought Love down eight times Sunday. Despite that onslaught, he was able to find J. Michael Sturdivant for a 32-yard TD in the third quarter to salvage his line slightly. It was the first time since Week 6 that Love had failed to throw multiple touchdowns, and just the second time all season. He'll get a Week 11 bye to heal up from Sunday's pummeling before facing Myles Garrett and the Rams in Week 12.

inj_report.long: Although Joe Burrow threw for 300 yards, both Higgins and Ja'Marr Chase found tough sledding against a Commanders secondary geared up to stop them. Higgins did salvage his fantasy night with his seventh touchdown catch of the season on a picturesque over-the-shoulder 31-yard grab down the left sideline on the first play after the two-minute warning in the first half. Higgins has six of his scoring receptions in the last five games heading into a favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Shough completed 25 of 42 passes for 222 yards and one touchdown with one interception in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears. He added 34 rushing yards on three carries.
inj_report.long: Despite the high volume of attempts, Shough couldn't get much going through the air while dealing with a ferocious Chicago pass rush that sacked him six times, including one for a fourth-quarter safety by Montez Sweat. Shough has gone four straight games without producing multiple TDs, posting a 4:3 TD:INT over that stretch while completing 67.3 percent of his passes with a weak 6.3 YPA. The second-year QB will likely need to be a lot more productive in Week 12 if the Saints are going to keep up with Joe Burrow and the Bengals.

inj_report.short: Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Facing a Colts defense down both Sauce Gardner (calf) and Charvarius Ward (knee), Collins looked primed for a big night early when he recorded a 42-yard touchdown grab to cap off Houston's second possession. However, C.J. Stroud proceeded to spread the ball around to nine different targets overall, leading to Collins tying his second-lowest reception tally and posting his third-lowest yardage total of the season. However, the star wideout did extend his touchdown streak to three games, and he'll next take aim at what has been an inconsistent Ravens secondary in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Burden caught two of three targets for 10 yards and added three yards on his only carry in Sunday's 21-13 win over New Orleans.
inj_report.long: It was the worst performance of the season for Burden, who suffered a concussion in the Bears' last game in Week 9 but used a bye week to clear the protocol and avoid missing any additional time. The second-year wideout saw his three-game scoring streak come to an end, and on the season he sports a 51-654-4 line on 69 targets through 10 contests. Burden will look to bounce back in a potential Week 12 barn burner against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen said Tuten aggravated a right ankle injury in Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants, while noting that an examination Monday revealed nothing "too bad," Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.
inj_report.long: Tuten carried 10 times for 33 yards and recorded three receptions for 20 yards before exiting the contest with 3:40 remaining, when his ankle got stepped on for the second time that day. Though the injury was to the same ankle/foot that has resulted in Tuten being listed on the Jacksonville injury report for three straight weeks, Coen seemed to imply that the aggravation isn't viewed as a major concern. Even so, Tuten's practice activity is likely to be affected in Week 12, putting his availability for next Sunday's game against the Titans in question.

inj_report.short: Watson completed 25 of 40 passes for 312 yards with no touchdowns and one interception while adding eight rushes for 49 yards and a score in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that remained with Cleveland.
inj_report.long: Watson helped the Browns overcome a 17-point first-half deficit, even though he didn't throw any touchdown passes for the fourth straight game. The veteran signal-caller did pile up the passing yardage against his old team, however, eclipsing 300 yards for the third straight game in the process. Watson also hit Harold Fannin with a critical 30-yard pass on his last pass attempt of the afternoon to set up Quinshon Judkins' game-winning rushing touchdown, and he'll next draw a highly favorable matchup against the Raiders in a Week 12 home matchup on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

inj_report.short: Swift carried the ball 13 times for 51 yards and caught both his targets for eight yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
inj_report.long: The Bears' offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye, and Swift wound up leading the backfield in scrimmage yards on the afternoon, highlighting his performance with a three-yard TD pass from Caleb Williams in the second quarter. Swift's 15 touches also led the backfield, as a returning Kyle Monangai got eased back into action with eight touches. Surprisingly, Salvon Ahmed also handled six carries, all in the fourth quarter when the game seemed well in hand. Swift did lose his third fumble of the season, a new career high, but the TD was his 11th of the year, also a new personal best. Monangai could see his workload increase as he puts his turf toe injury further behind him, but Swift seems to have a firm hold of the No. 1 job heading into a Week 12 clash with the team that drafted him in 2020, the Lions.

inj_report.short: Flowers caught eight of 11 targets for 97 yards in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
inj_report.long: No other Raven caught more than four passes or saw more than six targets as Flowers continues to build chemistry with new quarterback Jacoby Brissett. The fourth-year wideout has posted a 14-171-0 line on 18 targets in Brissett's first two starts for Baltimore, immediately establishing a strong floor. Flowers will try to keep rolling in Week 12 against what has been a surprisingly vulnerable Texans defense.

inj_report.short: Purdy completed 21 of 26 pass attempts for 255 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
inj_report.long: Purdy remained effective despite facing the vaunted Vikings defense, which had allowed just six touchdown passes through nine games. He threw touchdown passes on three of San Francisco's first four drives, connecting with George Kittle for scores of 17 and eight yards before finding Mike Evans for a four-yard touchdown in Evans' first action since Week 6 due to an Achilles injury. Purdy will take a stellar 23:5 TD:INT into another tough matchup on paper in Week 12 against the Seahawks, who held him to a season-low 189 passing yards in Week 5.

inj_report.short: Washington secured eight of 17 targets for 103 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Washington led the Jaguars across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and his day could have been even better had what appeared to be an acrobatic touchdown catch in the back of the end zone early in the fourth quarter not been ruled incomplete. Washington still made several tough grabs throughout the afternoon against a stingy Giants secondary, and he now has consecutive 100-yard efforts for the first time in 2026. Washington needs just 100 receiving yards to eclipse his career high of 847 heading into a very favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Titans next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Nabers brought in seven of 12 targets for 55 yards and a touchdown in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Nabers was in the familiar position of leading the Giants across the board in receptions, receiving yards and targets, and the third-year star also snapped a four-game touchdown drought with an eight-yard grab in the second quarter. Nabers has at least five catches in eight straight contests and three double-digit target tallies within that span, and the 2024 first-round pick should continue to be the subject of plenty of J.J. McCarthy's attention in a Week 12 road matchup against the Colts next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Brown rushed six times for six yards and brought in five of eight targets for 30 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: As his final line indicates, Brown was completely stonewalled by a talented Commanders run defense, although backfield mate Samaje Perine, who equaled Brown's carry total, was able to average 4.3 yards per tote with his opportunities and  added 71 receiving yards. Brown did find a way to make his usual impact as a receiver, tying for the team lead in receptions and finishing second in targets to Ja'Marr Chase. Brown's carry and rushing yardage totals were both season lows, but he should have appreciably better conditions for production on the ground in a Week 12 home matchup against the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Watson caught three of five targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to Minnesota.
inj_report.long: The Packers' passing game was stifled as the Vikings sacked Jordan Love eight times, giving him little time to find receivers like Watson. The 37 yards were a season low for the fifth-year wideout, while the three grabs tied for his lowest volume of 2026. Watson will take a 52-916-7 line on 79 targets through 10 contests into a Week 11 bye before facing the Rams in Week 12.

inj_report.short: Olave caught nine of 15 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: One week after taking a back seat to rookie Jordyn Tyson, Olave re-emerged as Tyler Shough's favorite downfield option, as he set a new season high in targets and topped 100 receiving yards for the fourth time in 2026. Tyson, meanwhile, caught only one pass on two targets, suggesting the Saints' aerial attack may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game. Olave will look to make an impact again in Week 12 against the Bengals.

inj_report.short: McBride caught nine of 14 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 34-7 loss to Kansas City. He added four yards on his only carry.
inj_report.long: Working with his fourth quarterback of the season in Josh Johnson, McBride dominated the 40-year-old's attention, as no other Cardinal got more than seven targets or hauled in more than four passes. The star tight end wasn't able to do much with the volume, however, as his longest gain went for a mere nine yards. Carson Beck (back) could be back under center in Week 12 against the Commanders, but that might not improve McBride's outlook, as he saw only five targets in Week 10 during the rookie QB's first NFL start.

inj_report.short: Cook rushed 22 times for 89 yards and a touchdown while catching two of three targets for three yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Cook extended his touchdown streak to nine games with a one-yard touchdown run in the second quarter. He accounted for all but five of Buffalo's rushing attempts as Josh Allen finished without one, but Cook came up short of 100 scrimmage yards for the first time since Week 4. The reigning NFL rushing yards leader continues to put up stellar production heading into Thursday night's home game against the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: Taylor rushed 11 times for 21 yards and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Taylor put some distance between himself and promising rookie backfield mate Seth McGowan in terms of workload, as the former outpaced his teammate in carries by an 11-3 margin, even with the latter exiting before halftime with a hamstring injury. However, the extra opportunity was a moot point, as Taylor couldn't find any space to operate as either a runner or receiver. Daniel Jones' mediocre play under center certainly isn't helping the ground attack's cause, and Taylor now has recorded less than 50 rushing yards in three of the last four contests. The star running back will have some additional time to prepare for a relatively favorable Week 12 home matchup against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that Darnold (quadriceps/rib) made a "good bit of progress" over the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and will start Sunday at San Francisco if he fares well during Wednesday's practice, Brady Henderson of ESPN.com reports.
inj_report.long: Darnold has been sidelined for the Seahawks' last two games due to a quad issue and a cracked rib, but he was back on the field Monday for a bonus practice coming out of the bye week. While Macdonald relayed that Darnold "looked great"  and took "a ton of reps" during what the coach referred to as more of a walk-through session, the Seahawks want to see how the veteran quarterback responds to a full-speed practice Wednesday before giving him the green light to start Week 12. After leading the Seahawks to their second Super Bowl championship in 2025, Darnold has endured a rough start to 2026, completing 60.2 percent of his passes and posting a 10:9 TD:INT while missing nearly four full games due to injury.

inj_report.short: Wilson caught three of five targets for 39 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Wilson led the team in receiving yards and targets as Geno Smith threw for just 176 yards, though Wilson wasn't on the receiving end of any of Smith's three touchdown passes. The Jets' No. 1 wideout hasn't scored since Week 5, and Wilson has fallen short of 45 receiving yards four times this season, though he has also topped 100 yards three times. Wilson will face a Dolphins defense in Week 12 that held him to a season-low 26 receiving yards in their Week 7 meeting.

inj_report.short: Golden caught five of nine targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
inj_report.long: The second-year wideout was the only Packer to have much success on offense, leading the team in catches, targets and receiving yards. Golden has reached 70 yards in three straight games and five of the last six, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 58-853-5 line on 101 targets through 10 contests. His next chance to add to those numbers will come in Week 12 against the Rams.

inj_report.short: Mayfield completed 20 of 33 passes for 187 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed six times for 36 yards in the Buccaneers' 31-21 loss to the Lions on Sunday. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Tampa Bay.
inj_report.long: Mayfield fought through foot and thumb injuries to take the field in a critical game for the 3-6 Buccaneers, but he wasn't able to keep pace with Jared Goff and Jahmyr Gibbs. Mayfield did throw multiple touchdown passes for the first time this season, hitting rookie Ted Hurst for scoring strikes of 23 and four yards. Mayfield's rushing yardage total was also a new season high, and he'll next take aim at the Panthers' beatable secondary in a Week 12 divisional home matchup on Monday night, Nov. 30.

inj_report.short: Williams (toe) was a full participant in Monday's practice, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.
inj_report.long: Listed as a limited participant on the Rams' initial Week 12 injury report posted Sunday, Williams quelled any concern about his status for Wednesday's game against the Packers by taking full reps a day later. Though his sore toe isn't expected to affect his workload, Williams nonetheless may find himself in a timeshare with Blake Corum, who has been the more productive option on the ground this season. Williams has totaled seven touchdowns and is averaging 4.4 yards per carry through 10 games, while Corum has scored six times and is averaging 5.3 yards per tote.

inj_report.short: Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception and notched six carries for five yards during Sunday's 38-24 victory against the Raiders.
inj_report.long: After a hit-or-miss first six appearances of the season, Nix has settled into a four-game stretch in which his passing yards have ranged from 222 to 237 weekly, a span in which he boasts a 6:2 TD:INT and 84 rushing yards and another score. He also displayed some promise with offseason acquisition Jaylen Waddle (3-61-0 on six targets) while connecting with TE Adam Trautman for his 12th touchdown pass in 10 contests. Nix will look to keep things rolling Friday at Pittsburgh.

inj_report.short: Young completed 22 of 30 passes for 254 yards and two touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 35-33 win over Baltimore.
inj_report.long: The fourth-year QB posted his best single-game completion rate of the season (73.3 percent) while tossing multiple TDs for the third time in the last six contests, a stretch in which he's compiled a 9:5 TD:INT. Both of Young's scores came in the first half, as he connected with Mitchell Evans on a 23-yard TD and Tetairoa McMillan on a seven-yard strike. Young will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against Tampa Bay.

inj_report.short: Hubbard carried the ball 27 times for 120 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens. He added a two-point conversion.
inj_report.long: The 27-year-old running back continues to shine, making two trips to the end zone for a second straight week and piling up at least 120 rushing yards for the third time in 2026. Hubbard is handling a bell-cow workload with no issues, and over six games since the Panthers' bye he's averaging nearly 25 touches a game while amassing 688 scrimmage yards and six rushing touchdowns. Jonathon Brooks (groin) seems close to coming off IR, but but he's unlikely to make much of a dent in Hubbard's role as long as the team's top RB is dominating. Hubbard faces a very tough test in Week 12 against a Tampa Bay defense that held him to just 60 combined yards and zero TDs in their first meeting in Week 7.

inj_report.short: Herbert entered the concussion protocol after Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets, Noah Furtado of The Athletic reports.
inj_report.long: Herbert completed 15 of 21 passes for 131 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions in Week 11, but he also endured six sacks, fumbled once and added 32 yards and one TD on his eight carries. It's unclear exactly when he picked up the head injury, but he'll be subject to the concussion protocol ahead of further game action. The Chargers take the field next Sunday against the Patriots.

inj_report.short: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.
inj_report.long: London was checked for a possible concussion in the fourth quarter of Week 10 action, but the result of the evaluation wasn't reported before the game concluded. Prior to his exit Sunday, he posted his third 100-yard game (109, to be exact) of the campaign on six catches and a season-high 12 targets. London will continue to operate as the Falcons' No. 1 WR after a Week 11 bye in the team's next game Sunday, Nov. 29, at Minnesota.

inj_report.short: Likely brought in one of three targets for 35 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Likely finished with season lows in reception and targets, although he did provide an impressive gain on his one catch. The breakout tight end was coming off a season-best 127-yard tally against the Commanders in Week 10, so Sunday's scant involvement can be described as an outlier. Despite the unremarkable performance, Likely still boasts a career-best 56-610-7 line across 10 games heading into a Week 12 road clash against the Colts next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Coleman reeled off 111 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries and hauled in four of five targets for 18 yards during Sunday's 38-24 win against the Raiders.
inj_report.long: Since returning from an IR stint due to a sprained ankle in Week 7, Coleman has increased his touch count in four consecutive contests, taking a stranglehold on the Broncos backfield in the process. As evidence, his 25 touches easily outpaced fellow RB J.K. Dobbins' one, which went for no yards. Coleman, a rookie fourth-round pick, also cracked the 100-yard mark on the ground for the first time in his career. With RJ Harvey (ankle) on injured reserve for at least one more game, Coleman again is set to act as a workhorse in Friday's road matchup with the Steelers.

inj_report.short: Milton completed 11 of 21 passes for 141 yards while rushing five times for seven yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass or interception through two starts. He rushed for just seven yards Sunday after notching 64 rushing yards against the Giants in his first start with the Eagles, but Milton avoided mistakes as the Eagles rode their defense and Saquon Barkley's legs to their third win of the season. Twelve of Milton's 21 passes were directed to DeVonta Smith (hamstring) in their first game together. Milton is poised to start on Thanksgiving against the Cowboys, with whom he appeared in four games last season. He was on Dallas' practice squad prior to signing with the Eagles in October.

inj_report.short: Rodgers completed 30 of 44 passes for 227 yards and one touchdown while rushing five times for 29 yards in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: Rodgers threw a 20-yard touchdown pass to Max Hurleman on Pittsburgh's final offensive play with 1:21 remaining in the fourth quarter, but that was too little too late, as the Eagles proceeded to run out the clock to drop the Steelers to 6-4. Hurleman stepped up down the stretch in his first NFL game after starting wide receiver DK Metcalf was disqualified. Rodgers had a four-game stretch in which he threw 11 touchdown passes while posting at least 235 passing yards in each outing, but he has failed to reach that yardage total in any of his last four starts while recording only four TDs during the latter stretch. Snapping out of this recent funk won't be easy for Rodgers against the stout Broncos defense Friday.

inj_report.short: McMillan caught six of nine targets for 71 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
inj_report.long: The second-year wideout posted his best yardage total since Week 6 while leading the Panthers in receiving yards, catches and targets. McMillan capped his solid performance with a seven-yard TD from Bryce Young in the second quarter. McMillan has slowed down since a torrid start to the season, but he still sports a 55-731-4 line on 87 targets through 10 games heading into a Week 12 clash with the Buccaneers.

inj_report.short: Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his only target for one yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich.
inj_report.long: The whole Patriots' offense struggled after Drake Maye (ankle) was knocked out of the game early, but Stevenson also didn't look to be in peak form after dealing with a knee issue during the practice week. Corey Kiner wound up leading the backfield with just 25 rushing yards on 10 totes. Stevenson will get a Week 11 bye to rest up, and if Maye's injury ends up sidelining him for an extended period, New England could lean heavily on its running game in Week 12 against the Chargers.

inj_report.short: Smith (hamstring) caught five of 12 targets for 41 yards in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: Smith was targeted on 12 of Joe Milton's 21 passes in the wide receiver's first game since Week 6. Milton has thrown for just 310 yards without a touchdown pass through two starts for the Eagles, so expectations should be tempered for the team's passing game as a whole, but Smith has reclaimed his role as the team's top pass catcher. Smith could make the most of his hefty target share Thursday against the generous Dallas secondary.

inj_report.short: Mendoza was 18-for-37 passing for 267 yards, three touchdowns and one interception and had four carries for 22 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss in Denver.
inj_report.long: After throwing for no touchdowns or interceptions in his first NFL start last Sunday against the Seahawks, Mendoza recorded the first scoring strike of his career on a 68-yard catch and run via RB Ashton Jeanty in Week 11. Mendoza also hooked up with Ian Thomas (19 yards) and Jack Bech (seven yards) for his other two TDs, but he followed up a 58.6 completion percentage in Week 10 with more misfires (19) than connections (18) this Sunday. Mendoza's next chance for game action is next Sunday at Cleveland.

inj_report.short: Warren rushed nine times for 28 yards and caught two of three targets for one yard in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: Warren finished with 29 yards on 11 touches compared to 34 yards on nine touches for Rico Dowdle, as Pittsburgh's backfield duo was held quiet for a second consecutive game. After recording at least 73 scrimmage yards in eight consecutive games to start the season, Warren has produced just 75 yards without a touchdown over the past two games. Warren and Dowdle should continue to split backfield touches Friday against the Broncos.

inj_report.long: Henry was checked for a concussion in the fourth quarter of the contest, but evidently passed all tests. Prior to his exit, Henry carried 13 times for 94 yards and a touchdown and hauled in four of his five targets for 17 yards. He also lost his second fumble of the season. Henry looks like he'll be ready to handle his normal role as the lead option out of the Baltimore backfield next Sunday against the Texans.

inj_report.long: Barkley appeared to be nursing a left arm injury in the aftermath of Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers, but it was instead two different health concerns that resulted in him being included on the Eagles' first Week 12 injury report. The Eagles are facing a quick turnaround this week with a Thursday matchup against the Cowboys, so Barkley could be in line for only light activity over the next two days as the team aims to keep him as fresh as possible for that contest. Head coach Nick Sirianni hasn't yet offered any indication that Barkley is in jeopardy of sitting out Thanksgiving Day.

inj_report.short: Rice secured all six targets for 53 yards in the Chiefs' 34-7 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Rice tied for the team lead in receptions and finished as the runner-up in targets to Travis Kelce. The veteran receiver averaged a modest 8.8 yards per catch, his third game in the last four with under 10.0 yards per reception. Rice has at least five catches in four consecutive contests heading into Thursday's Week 12 Thanksgiving showdown against the Bills in Buffalo.

inj_report.short: Pickens secured seven of 10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 51-30 win over the Titans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Pickens played second fiddle to CeeDee Lamb (11-132-1) in Sunday's blowout win, but that still equated to a rewarding effort for the franchise-tagged receiver. The game marked Pickens' third 100-yard tally of the season and second straight, and he now has seen double-digit targets in four of the last six games overall. Pickens rounded out his day Sunday with his sixth touchdown reception of the campaign on a 10-yard catch in the latter portion of the second quarter, and he should be teed up for another busy day when the Cowboys host the Eagles for a Week 12 matchup on Thanksgiving Day.

inj_report.short: McCord completed 12 of 33 passes for 102 yards, no touchdowns and one interception in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He also rushed twice for nine yards.
inj_report.long: McCord has thrown for just 311 yards without a touchdown pass in his first two NFL starts. The 2025 sixth-round pick of the Eagles is poised to make at least two more starts while Malik Willis (abdomen) is on IR. Miami's lone win of the season came against the Jets, whom the Dolphins will host in Week 12.

inj_report.short: Evans (Achilles) caught six of seven targets for 109 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
inj_report.long: Evans picked up where he left off in his first action since Week 6, leading the team in catches, receiving yards and targets. He has 316 receiving yards in his last three healthy games and has scored four times in seven appearances for the 49ers, including a four-yard touchdown catch in the second quarter of Sunday night's win. Evans will likely have his practice reps managed as usual ahead of a Week 12 home game against the Seahawks, but he looks poised to continue suiting up, barring a setback.

inj_report.short: Williams brought in all four targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in the Lions' 31-21 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: The highlight of Williams' afternoon was a 57-yard touchdown reception early in the third quarter where he got free on a post pattern, and the fifth-year veteran also led the Lions in receiving yards. Williams has at least four receptions in four of the last five games, and Sunday marked his third game with more than 90 receiving yards. The 2022 first-round pick is now averaging 17.0 yards per reception heading into Thursday's Week 12 home matchup against the Bears.

inj_report.short: Jeanty tallied 11 carries for 79 yards and gathered in five of eight targets for 90 yards and one touchdown during Sunday's 38-24 loss at Denver.
inj_report.long: Jeanty's 169 yards from scrimmage amounted to the second-highest single-game total of his career after going for 188 such yards against the Texans in Week 16 of last season. His performance was fueled by a 68-yard catch and run for a touchdown and a 46-yard rush, the latter of which marked his first of 20-plus yards on the campaign. Jeanty also broke a streak of four straight contests falling short of 10 carries, but considering No. 2 RB Mike Washington also earned nine runs in Week 11, the Raiders backfield remains a committee ahead of next Sunday's outing at Cleveland.

inj_report.short: Pollard rushed 21 times for 110 yards and failed to bring in his only target in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Pollard eclipsed the century mark on the ground for the third time in the last four games, lighting up his old team for multiple productive gains on the afternoon. The veteran back has been a bright spot in a dismal 1-9 start for Tennessee, despite game script often working against the ground attack in the second halves of the Titans' contests. Pollard remains firmly on pace for a fifth straight 1,000-yard season heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.long: Diggs finished tied for second on the Commanders in receptions and as the runner-up in targets, although he produced modest yardage with his opportunities. The veteran wideout has at least four catches in seven of the first nine games of his tenure in Washington, and he'll carry a 40-431-6 line into a Week 12 road matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel said Monday that DeVito is the team's starting quarterback, Mike Reiss of ESPN.com reports. "We're excited about that. He had a good preseason, and Tommy's improved," Vrabel said of DeVito.
inj_report.long: With Drake Maye (fibula) hurt early in Week 10 against Detroit, DeVito stepped in at quarterback but managed to complete just 12 of 24 pass attempts for 81 yards, a touchdown and an interception. He added 19 yards on four carries. The 28-year-old does have some starting experience -- he helmed the Giants offense for eight starts between 2023 and 2024 -- but he didn't play at all in 2025. For now, the Patriots are at least communicating that they'll stand pat and not look for help at quarterback outside the organization. However, the team is barely hanging on in the AFC playoff race with a 5-5 record, and with only rookie Behren Morton on the active roster as a healthy option to DeVito, the team may still look elsewhere if DeVito is unable to show better production.

inj_report.short: Judkins rushed 10 times for 38 yards and a touchdown and brought in three of five targets for 33 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Judkins' rushing volume was at a season-low level, but the second-year back managed to record his fourth rushing touchdown of the campaign on a five-yard run with just under a minute remaining. That proved to be the game-winning score, and Judkins also mustered his second-highest receiving yardage tally of the campaign. The 2025 first-round pick is averaging just 3.4 yards per carry, however, so he remains far from efficient heading into a Week 11 bye ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Ward completed 21 of 30 passes for 248 yards with two touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing twice for three yards and another score in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.
inj_report.long: Ward's final line belies his struggles somewhat, as a Cowboys defense that made a defensive playcaller switch brought him down for five sacks and forced a lost fumble on one of them at Dallas' 20-yard line. Ward did manage to connect with Carnell Tate (59 yards) and Calvin Ridley (12 yards) for his pair of TD passes, the first coming when the rookie wideout alertly got up after not being touched and the second on a broken play where Ward threw across the field after buying several extra seconds with his legs. Ward also had a one-yard touchdown run in the third quarter, and despite Tennessee's team-level misery, the second-year signal-caller has thrown for at least 231 yards and two touchdowns in three consecutive games heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Odunze caught all four of his targets for 45 yards in Sunday's 21-13 win over the Saints.
inj_report.long: The four grabs led the Bears on the afternoon, as the offense looked a little sluggish coming out of its bye. Odunze's longest gain went for just 19 yards, and rookie Zavion Thomas wound up leading the team in receiving yards thanks to a 40-yard connection with Caleb Williams in the third quarter. Odunze has caught exactly four passes in four straight games, a stretch in which he's produced a 16-261-1 line on 22 targets. The third-year wideout will try to get more involved in a potential Week 12 barn burner against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Gordon rushed 11 times for 69 yards while catching two of three targets for minus-2 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills.
inj_report.long: After a quiet first half, Gordon got free for a 24-yard run on the first possession of the second half to set up Miami's third and final field goal of the afternoon. Gordon was Miami's most effective offensive player as usual, as Kyle McCord threw for just 102 yards in the latter's second NFL start. This was Gordon's seventh consecutive game with at least 64 scrimmage yards, but he'll take a four-game touchdown drought into a Week 12 home game against the Jets.

inj_report.short: Brissett completed 24 of 37 passes for 276 yards and a touchdown with an interception in Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers. He added seven rushing yards on two carries.
inj_report.long: It was another decent showing for the veteran quarterback, and his first TD pass in two games as a Raven came on a trick that involved a direct snap to Derrick Henry, who flipped it Brissett for a 52-yard strike to Rashod Bateman. Brissett has also kept Zay Flowers relevant, feeding the wideout 18 targets for a 14-171-0 line. Baltimore's passing attack will try to keep improving in Week 12 against the Texans.

inj_report.short: LaPorta (ankle) was limited at Monday's walkthrough, Nolan Bianchi of The Detroit News reports.
inj_report.long: With a Thanksgiving matchup on tap against the Bears, the Lions are easing into the week following Sunday's 31-21 win against the Buccaneers, when LaPorta gathered in three of six targets for 62 yards. He's nursing an ankle issue in the wake of that contest, and he may need to be listed as full Tuesday and/or Wednesday in order to avoid a designation ahead of Thursday's game.

inj_report.short: Penix completed 23 of 43 passes for 286 yards with no touchdowns and one interception and rushed four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 loss to the Chiefs on Sunday. He also fumbled once but recovered.
inj_report.long: Penix struggled while the game was still in question, but he did manage to pad his stats some down the stretch as the Falcons unsuccessfully tried to overcome their deficit. Penix connected with eight different targets overall on the afternoon, and he ultimately finished with a season high in passing yards. Penix has now tossed six interceptions in the last three games, however, and he'll look to regroup during the Week 11 bye before tackling a difficult matchup against the Vikings on the road on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.long: While he didn't get much target volume, Loveland was still able to make an impact with a 15-yard TD reception in the second quarter that saw him hurdle a defender without even breaking stride on his way to the end zone. It was the tight end's third score of the season, all of which have come during Chicago's current five-game win streak, and after a slow start to the season Loveland has delivered a 27-282-3 line on 37 targets during that period. He'll look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Hall rushed 20 times for 86 yards while catching all three of his targets for 14 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Hall reached 100 scrimmage yards for the second consecutive game while scoring his first touchdown since Week 1 on a seven-yard reception in the second quarter. Both Hall and Braelon Allen (17 touches for 84 yards) were heavily involved as the Jets snapped a five-game losing streak and were able to stick with the ground game. Hall has 56 touches to Allen's 36 in three games since the former returned from a quadriceps injury. After dropping the Chargers to 1-9 with Sunday's win, Hall and the Jets will face the 1-9 Dolphins in Week 12.

inj_report.long: Moore's four-yard touchdown catch in the second quarter gave him his first multi-game regular-season touchdown streak since Weeks 15 and 16 of the 2025 campaign with the Bears. He briefly left the game later in the first half to have his knee looked at but promptly returned and ultimately reached the 90-yard threshold for a second consecutive game while leading the team in targets. Barring a setback with his knee on a short week, Moore should continue to work as Buffalo's top wide receiver Thanksgiving night against the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: Kittle caught all three of his targets for 34 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
inj_report.long: Kittle scored on both of his first-half catches, capping San Francisco's opening drive with a 17-yard touchdown before adding an eight-yard score in the first minute of the second quarter. The multi-touchdown performance was especially impressive considering the Vikings came in having allowed just one touchdown on a league-low 33 catches to tight ends. Kittle has been one of the top performers at his position as usual, with seven touchdown catches in 10 games, though his streak of consecutive outings with at least four catches ended at eight games. Up next for Kittle is a Week 12 home game against the Seahawks.

inj_report.short: Head coach Shane Steichen announced Friday that Richardson will be the Colts' starting quarterback moving forward after the team waived Daniel Jones.
inj_report.long: Richardson made a cameo in Thursday's 26-3 loss at Houston, taking over for Jones for Indianapolis' final possession, but the former logged just a two-yard carry and two incompletions before the Texans ate up the final 6:50 of the contest. A 2023 first-round pick, Richardson himself hasn't started since Week 16 of the 2024 campaign, making just four brief appearances the past two seasons combined, but he'll have a chance to boost his value (or not) in the final year of his rookie contract.

inj_report.short: Tate brought in two of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 51-30 loss to the Cowboys on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Tate had a fairly non-descript day overall despite the Titans' 30-point output, but he rewarded fantasy managers with a 59-yard catch-and run touchdown in the third quarter on which he alertly got up and ran down the left sideline after Cowboys defenders failed to touch him while he was down. The rookie fourth overall pick was making his return from a two-game absence due to a shoulder injury, and the score served as Tate's second of his career, both which have come in his last three games. Tate has at least 58 receiving yards in five of the last six contests, including in three straight, heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Jaguars next Sunday.

inj_report.long: One week after logging 13 targets as Tyler Shough's top downfield option, Tyson all but disappeared as Chris Olave instead saw WR1-worthy volume. The Saints' aerial attack simply may not be able to support both wideouts in the same game, which would mark Tyson as a volatile, but high-ceiling, fantasy asset for the rest of the season. The rookie will try to bounce back in Week 12 against the Bengals.

Kelce will take a 41-586-4 line into Thursday's Thanksgiving Day road showdown against the Bills.

Fannin's chemistry with Deshaun Watson has been outstanding, and the second-year tight end now has at least 91 receiving yards in three of the past four games. Fannin will remain a central figure in Cleveland's impressive air attack when the team returns to action in a home matchup against the Raiders on Sunday, Nov. 29, following a Week 11 bye.

inj_report.short: McConkey caught five of eight targets for 37 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
inj_report.long: His longest gain went for just 11 yards, but McConkey was deadly in the red zone, connecting with Justin Herbert on scores of 11 and six yards in the fourth quarter as the Chargers tried to mount a late comeback. Herbert was placed in the concussion protocol after the game after taking six sacks, and if he end up missing any time, it would put a big damper on McConkey's fantasy outlook with undrafted rookie DJ Uiagalelei being the Bolts' backup, unless Trey Lance (groin) is able to return from IR. McConkey has had plenty of trouble staying on the field himself this year, of course, and he'll take a 22-323-3 line on 32 targets through seven contests into a Week 12 clash with the Patriots.

inj_report.long: Concepcion finished second on the Browns in targets behind tight end Harold Fannin, who had nine. However, whereas Fannin was able to turn his looks into seven receptions and 91 yards, Concepcion posted a much more modest 3-21-0 line. The rookie wideout departed to the medical tent during the first half of the game due to an undisclosed issue, but he was able to quickly return. Concepcion hasn't put up prolific numbers this season, but he does have at least three receptions in eight of his 10 appearances. Cleveland is on bye in Week 11, so Concepcion will next suit up Sunday, Nov. 29, against Las Vegas.

inj_report.short: Jones rushed eight times for 30 yards and a touchdown while catching his lone target for 13 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: Jones tied the game with an 11-yard rushing touchdown in the first quarter, but the 49ers outscored the Vikings 21-3 in the second quarter, forcing Minnesota into a more pass-heavy approach. Jordan Mason led the team with 38 rushing yards on 11 carries. Jones and Mason should continue to split carries in Week 12 against the Falcons, with Jones offering greater upside as a pass catcher.

inj_report.short: Hockenson (wrist) caught six of seven targets for 55 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers.
inj_report.long: In his return from a one-game absence, Hockenson finished second on the team in receiving yards behind Justin Jefferson's 86. Hockenson showed promising chemistry with Kirk Cousins after the veteran TE sat out Cousins' return to Minnesota during the Week 10 win over Green Bay. Cousins was under center for the Vikings in the 2023 regular season, when Hockenson set career highs with 95 catches for 960 yards. Hockenson hasn't surpassed 455 yards in a regular season since, though he's on pace to do so this year, with 41 catches for 383 yards and three touchdowns through nine appearances heading into a Week 12 home game against the Falcons.

inj_report.long: Though Boston played 58 of 68 offensive snaps in the Browns' Week 10 win over the Texans, he was managing a toe injury leading up to that contest that may have hindered his effectiveness. He was limited to just a 16-yard reception on two targets in the win over Houston and appears to still be managing the injury coming off a Week 11 bye. The Browns will post their first Week 12 injury report Wednesday, when it will be known whether Boston is still tending to the toe issue or a different health concern.

inj_report.long: Mason had one more carry and eight more rushing yards than Aaron Jones, but Jones' totals included an 11-yard touchdown run in the first quarter. They have worked in a near-even split when both veteran RBs have been healthy, but Mason hasn't scored since Week 1. inj_report.short: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.
inj_report.long: The tight end's numbers reflected how much time his quarterback had to look downfield, as Jordan Love got sacked eight times in the rout. Kraft has been held to just one catch in back-to-back games, and he heads into a Week 11 bye with a 37-370-3 line on 56 targets through 10 games, with the Rams as the next opponent on the horizon in Week 12.

inj_report.short: Goedert was listed as a limited participant on Monday's practice estimate due to a shin injury.
inj_report.long: Philadelphia gauged Goedert as limited to kick off Week 12 prep after he played 47 of 53 snaps while turning his lone target into a 38-yard reception during Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers. Goedert won't have much time to heal up from the shin issue while the Eagles prepare for a Thursday matchup with the Cowboys, but the fact that he avoided being listed as a non-participant on the first injury report of the week is generally a good sign for his chances of being cleared for game day.

inj_report.short: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Making his return from a four-game absence due to a groin injury, Montgomery functioned as the clear lead back with Woody Marks (concussion) unavailable. The former put together the best rushing yardage total of his brief Texans tenure, handling his highest number of carries since Week 4 of his 2023 debut campaign with the Lions. Montgomery also was encouragingly involved in a complementary role in the passing game, and he'll now have some extra time to recover from Thursday's workload ahead of a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29. However, if Marks is able to clear concussion protocol ahead of that contest, Montgomery will see his touch count take a hit.

inj_report.short: Okonkwo brought in four of five targets for 66 yards in the Commanders' 22-20 win over the Bengals on Monday night.
inj_report.long: Okonkwo contributed his game-long 32-yard grab on his first catch of the night, and the veteran tight end went on to finish second in receiving yards for the Commanders. He also contributed a key 13-yard grab on Washington's penultimate drive that culminated in a key field goal, and in all, three of his four receptions resulted in first downs. Okonkwo has at least four catches in three straight games but still is seeking his first touchdown of the season heading into a Week 12 road matchup against the Cardinals on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Hampton carried the ball 14 times for 89 yards and caught his only target for four yards in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
inj_report.long: While he's still not seeing a consistent bell-cow workload, Hampton has turned his season around over the last three games, racking up 254 rushing yards and a TD while averaging 5.2 yards per carry. Keaton Mitchell left Sunday's game early with a knee injury, but his absence appeared to provide a bigger boost to Kimani Vidal, who wound up logging nine touches and 54 scrimmage yards. Hampton will look to keep rolling in Week 12 against the Patriots.

inj_report.short: Strange caught all three of his targets for 16 yards during Sunday's 23-18 loss to the Giants.
inj_report.long: Strange was able to notch at least three catches for the first time since Week 6, but he still finished with fewer than 20 receiving yards for the second straight week and third time overall this year. The tight end has now reeled in 35 of 43 targets for 381 yards and two touchdowns over 10 contests during the 2026 season.

inj_report.short: Washington caught three of six targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 26-9 loss to the Bills. He rushed two times for 11 yards.
inj_report.long: Washington's six targets were third on the team, trailing Caleb Douglas (10) and Greg Dulcich (seven) on a day when Kyle McCord attempted 33 passes. Washington has just one touchdown this season and has yet to reach 70 receiving yards in any game in 2026. There's not much to like about the wideout's fantasy prospects moving forward this season.

inj_report.short: Meyers brought in four of 10 targets for 85 yards in the Jaguars' 23-18 loss to the Giants on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Meyers finished second across the board to Parker Washington in receptions, receiving yards and targets for the Jaguars on the afternoon, and the latter pair of totals also established and tied a season high, respectively. Meyers' yardage and reception tallies have fluctuated this season, but Sunday's performance underscores the fact he remains a key complementary piece of the Jaguars' typically efficient air attack. Meyers will look to exploit a favorable Week 12 matchup against the Titans defense at home next Sunday.

inj_report.short: Flournoy caught just one pass for 11 yards on one target in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: The Cowboys' slot receiver drew just one look on Dak Prescott's 33 pass attempts. He'd caught multiple passes in all 10 games leading up to Sunday's contest. A favorite target of Prescott in the red zone, Flournoy will try to rebound at home against the Eagles on Thanksgiving, when he'll be playable on three-game fantasy slates for Thursday.

inj_report.short: Sampson rushed four times for six yards and caught four of six targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
inj_report.long: Sampson hardly carries the ball for Cleveland and is merely the pass-catching complement to Quinshon Judkins out of the backfield. Across five games this season, Sampson has rushed 19 times for 79  yards while adding 16 catches for 152 yards on 22 targets. He's playable in PPR fantasy leagues as a desperation RB2 option, particularly in games for which the Browns are projected to play from behind.

inj_report.long: Charbonnet was eased in to the mix in Weeks 8 and 9, going from nine touches in the first contest to 17 in the latter. This time around, though, he doubled up fellow RB Jadarian Price in touches (10) and more than did so in terms from yards from scrimmage (44). It may signal that Charbonnet is the Seahawks' clear-cut No. 1 backfield option moving forward, but he won't have a chance to prove as much until after the team's Week 11 bye on Sunday, Nov. 29, at San Francisco.

inj_report.short: Allen rushed 16 times for 75 yards while catching his lone target for nine yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Allen's 16 carries matched his total from the previous two games combined, as he had seen a downtick in opportunities since fellow RB Breece Hall returned from a quadriceps injury. Hall led the backfield once again with 100 scrimmage yards and a touchdown on 23 touches, but Allen was a key part of the game plan as well in the run-heavy win. The Jets will face a one-win team for a second consecutive game in Week 12 at Miami, which could allow Allen to stay involved alongside Hall.

inj_report.short: Shakir caught five of nine targets for 101 yards while rushing twice for two yards in Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Shakir led the Bills in receiving yards in the absence of TE Dalton Kincaid (thumb/ankle), posting 10 more than DJ Moore, who had one more target than Shakir. Sunday marked Shakir's first time reaching the 100-yard threshold since a 110-yard showing in Week 12 of last season. Shakir will look to build on this outing as he searches for his second TD of the season Thursday against the Chiefs.

inj_report.short: Mitchell caught two passes for 30 yards on three targets in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Even with Omar Cooper (ankle) and Isaiah Williams (ribs) inactive, Mitchell's role didn't change, as his three targets tied with two other teammates for second on the team behind Garrett Wilson's five on a day the Jets called 37 run plays to just 22 passes. Mitchell has just one touchdown this season and has only 14 catches for 212 yards and no touchdowns in six games surrounding his 7-142-1 receiving performance from Week 8 against the Raiders. He's a big-play specialist in an offense that prefers to feed Wilson and its running backs.

inj_report.short: Metcalf won't receive a suspension after he was ejected from Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles, but the NFL is still reviewing discipline for the receiver that could include a fine, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.
inj_report.long: Metcalf was disqualified with 4:53 remaining in the third quarter Sunday after he attempted to poke Eagles defensive back Cooper DeJean in the eye. He was flagged for unsportsmanlike conduct in what was his second major transgression of the game; Metcalf previously drew an unnecessary roughness penalty in the first half, when he held his block of DeJean well after a play had finished. Though Metcalf won't miss further game action as a result of his ejection, he may have already lost the faith of his fantasy managers heading into a Week 12 matchup with the Broncos on Friday. Metcalf has hauled in just 36 of his 74 targets (48.6 percent catch rate) and has scored just two touchdowns on the season while topping 60 receiving yards in only two of his 10 appearances.

inj_report.long: With the Jaguars chasing points and playing from behind most of the afternoon, Bhayshul Tuten and Rodrgiuez combined for just 14 carries, while Trevor Lawrence dropped back to pass 50 times. Rodriguez's catch was just his fifth of the season, and he's handled single-digit carries in eight of 10 contests. He's merely an insurance policy behind Tuten in fantasy.

inj_report.short: Dike caught six of seven targets for 69 yards during Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: Dike was able to reel in multiple passes for the third straight game, and his six snags set a new season high for the second-year pro. The 24-year-old paced the team in targets Sunday, narrowly edging out fellow wide receivers Calvin Ridley (six) and Carnell Tate (five). Dike will have a chance to continue carving out a more substantial role for himself on offense moving forward with Wan'Dale Robinson (ankle) sidelined for the rest of the 2026 campaign.

inj_report.short: Tucker caught two of 10 targets for 50 yards during Sunday's 38-24 loss to the Broncos.
inj_report.long: Tucker finished with a team-high 10 targets, but he was unable to get on the same page with quarterback Fernando Mendoza for the majority of the game. Most of the wide receiver's production came on a 39-yard catch in the fourth quarter, and he has now combined to reel in three of 12 targets for 59 yards over Mendoza's first two career starts.

inj_report.short: Henry caught two of three passes for 22 yards during the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions on Sunday in Munich.
inj_report.long: Both of Henry's catches of 10 and 12 yards came on the Patriots' first offensive drive of the game, which ended with a 33-yard field goal by Andy Borregales. Unfortunately for the Patriots, Drake Maye suffered an ankle injury on the play prior to the field goal and was unable to return, and the offense struggled to move down the field with backup Tommy DeVito under center. Maye will undergo more tests once the team has returned to home soil, but the good news for the Patriots is that they are on a bye for Week 11, so the third-year quarterback has more time to heal before New England's next game in Week 12 against the Chargers on Sunday, Nov. 29. Henry's two catches Sunday were his fewest since Week 3 against the Jaguars (one), and the veteran tight end has a 34-383-2 receiving line on 40 targets through 10 regular-season games.

The veteran tight end now has consecutive one-catch, 11-yard tallies after recording multiple receptions in each of his first eight games of the season, and Schultz's production will remain hard to trust heading into a Week 12 home matchup against the Ravens on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Head coach DeMeco Ryans said Monday that Marks (concussion) is "trending in the right direction," and the Texans "are hopeful to have him" for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.
inj_report.long: After sustaining a concussion in a Nov. 15 loss to the Browns, Marks was unable to clear the five-step protocol on a short week and ended up sitting out this past Thursday's 26-3 win over the Colts. Since then, Marks appears to have progressed on some level through the protocol, though it's not yet clear if he'll be available to practice when the Texans kick off Week 12 prep Wednesday. If Marks ends up getting the green light to play versus the Ravens, he may be part of a timeshare in the backfield or be forced to settle for No. 2 duties behind David Montgomery (groin), who returned from a four-game absence in Week 11 to run for a season-high 107 yards.

inj_report.short: Gesicki brought in five of six targets for 77 yards in the Bengals' 22-20 loss to the Commanders on Monday night.
inj_report.long: The veteran tight end finished with a team-high yardage total while coming just a yard short of equaling his best tally of the season as well. Gesicki's biggest catch came late in the fourth quarter on the Bengals' final drive, when he hauled in a 32-yard pass from Joe Burrow over the middle to get the Bengals down to  the Commanders' 33-yard line. Gesicki's production continues to have some game-to-game volatility, but he'll draw another favorable matchup in a Week 12 home clash with the Saints on Sunday.

inj_report.short: Samuel logged two carries for 27 yards, gathered in three of four targets for 20 yards and returned two kickoffs for 57 yards during Sunday's 35-10 win against the Vikings in Mexico City.
inj_report.long: Samuel didn't come close to replicating the 109 yards from scrimmage and two TDs on six touches that he accrued during a Week 10 shootout in Dallas, but he continued to mix into the offense in all realms, as he's ranged from two to eight touches in each of his seven appearances this season. Overall, he's averaging 11.7 yards per catch and a whopping 13.1 yards per carry to go with five total touchdowns in 2026, making him one big play away from producing weekly.
