inj_report.short: Aubrey made his lone field-goal attempt and all six PATs in Sunday's 51-30 win over the Titans.
inj_report.long: The Cowboys scored touchdowns on each of their first six possessions against Tennessee, so Aubrey was busy kicking extra points. His field goal was good from 49 yards in the second half. It's been a struggle at times for Aubrey this season, as he's made just 20 of 25 field-goal tries through 11 games, but he's 31-for-33 on extra points in Dallas' high-octane offense.

inj_report.short: Butker made both of his field-goal attempts while going 4-for-4 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 34-7 win over the Cardinals.
inj_report.long: Butker was able to make multiple field goals in a contest for the first time since Week 6, and most importantly, he didn't miss a kick. The kicker made both field goals in the second quarter, converting attempts from 40 and 44 yards. Butker has now gone 14-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 2-for-8 from 50-plus yards, while converting 31 of 32 PATs over 10 contests so far during the 2026 season.

inj_report.short: Fitzgerald went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made all three of his PATs during Sunday's 35-33 win over the Ravens.
inj_report.long: Fitzgerald was able to make multiple field-goal tries for the second straight week and seventh time overall this season. The kicker made a 33-yard field goal in the third quarter before he converted a 37-yarder with 1:44 left in the fourth quarter, ultimately putting the Panthers in front 35-33. Fitzgerald has now gone 17-for-19 on field-goal attempts, including 5-for-5 from 50-plus yards, while converting 21 of 26 extra-point tries over 10 contests so far during the 2026 season.

inj_report.short: Ryland made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 34-7 loss to the Chiefs.
inj_report.long: Playing with their third- and fourth-string quarterbacks, the Cardinals have mustered a total of 13 points over their last two games. Ryland has minimal fantasy appeal in an offense struggling to simply move the ball. On the season, he's 22-for-24 on field-goal tries and 17-for-18 on PATs across 11 games.

inj_report.short: Gay made his lone field-goal attempt and all three of his extra-point tries during the Raiders' 38-24 loss to the Broncos on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Gay has attempted only one field goal in three of his last four outings, and his lone try Sunday was a chip shot from 28 yards out. He's 22-for-24 on field-goal attempts through 11 regular-season games, and he's ranked fifth in the NFL in made field goals. The Raiders will hit the road for Week 12 against the Browns on Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Zvada made three of four field-goal attempts and both PATs in Sunday's 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
inj_report.long: The rookie kicker continues to have his ups and downs. While he was good from 53, 54 and 43 yards, Zvada missed a chip shot from 32 yards on the opening drive of the second half that left coach John Harbaugh shaking his head. Zvada continues to be a bit of a liability, as he's made just 11 of 18 field-goal attempts over his last six games. Harbaugh is clearly growing more frustrated by the week, and it could lead to the Giants making a move at the position.

inj_report.short: Dicker made his lone field-goal attempt and all three PATs in Sunday's 27-24 loss to the Jets.
inj_report.long: Dicker's field goal was drilled from 52 yards, and he's now 19-for-21 on field-goal tries and 15-for-15 on extra points through 10 games this season. In a Chargers offense struggling mightily to score points, Dicker's fantasy value has tanked this season.

inj_report.short: McPherson made one of his two field-goal attempts and all five PATs in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday.
inj_report.long: McPherson converted a 24-yard field-goal attempt on the first drive of the game. The kicker proceeded to miss a 43-yarder in the second quarter of the contest, though the miss did not end up mattering to the final result of the game. McPherson is now 13-for-14 on field-goal attempts and 33-for-33 on PATs over nine contests this season.

inj_report.short: Moody went 2-for-2 on field-goal attempts and made his only PAT during Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs.
inj_report.long: Moody was signed by the Falcons off the Ravens' practice squad Tuesday, and he was able to put together a perfect debut with the team in Week 10. The kicker converted a 28-yard field-goal try in the second quarter before later adding a 38-yard make in the fourth. With Atlanta's bye week in Week 11, Moody's next chance to build on Sunday's performance will come in Week 12 against the Vikings.

inj_report.short: McLaughlin made all three of his extra-point attempts in Sunday's 31-21 loss to the Lions.
inj_report.long: After making multiple field goals in four straight games leading up to Sunday's game, McLaughlin didn't attempt a field goal for just the second time this season. The veteran kicker remains perfect on 43 kicks this season, going 22-for-22 on field goals and 21-for-21 on PATs. He's a valuable fantasy kicker headed into next Monday night's home date with the Panthers.

inj_report.short: Szmyt made two of his three field-goal attempts and all three of his PATs in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Szmyt knocked through field goals from 49 and 26 yards in Sunday's contest. The kicker stumbled in the fourth quarter, missing a 54-yard attempt with 11:02 remaining that would've brought the game within a point. Szmyt is now 21-for-24 on field-goal attempts and 15-for-16 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

inj_report.short: Elliott went 4-for-4 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 19-16 win over the Steelers.
inj_report.long: The Eagles kicker accounted for 13 of the team's 19 points, as he was good from 41, 29, 53 and 55 yards on his field goals. It was Elliott's first game with multiple field goals made since Week 4 against the Rams. That's how broken the Philadelphia offense has been for an extended period, and it doesn't project to get any better moving forward with Joe Milton at the controls. Elliott will be a hold-your-nose fantasy play in a theoretically high-scoring environment Thursday against the Cowboys, but it will be a movable force against a stoppable object when the Dallas defense squares off with the Eagles offense.

inj_report.short: Stevens made his only field-goal attempt and was successful on all three of his extra-point tries in Thursday's 24-21 win over the Giants.
inj_report.long: Stevens began the scoring in the contest with a 46-yard field goal early in the second period. That ended up being his only FG try of the game, but he made all three of his PATs. Stevens continued what has been a mostly fine rookie campaign -- he's made 17 of 20 field-goal attempts, with all three of his misses coming from 50-plus yards. However, he's just 15-for-18 on point-after tries.

inj_report.short: Sanders made both of his field-goal attempts and all three PATs in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Chargers.
inj_report.long: Sanders got the scoring started with a 50-yard field goal to cap the opening drive of the game. He later made one from 24 yards in the third quarter. Sanders has been a bright spot for the Jets this season, as he entered play Sunday leading the league in field-goal attempts (28) and makes (25), and he further boosted his conversion rate. The Jets have struggled to turn red-zone possessions into touchdowns this season, making Sanders a valuable fantasy kicker.

inj_report.short: Reichard went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point try during Sunday's 35-10 loss to the 49ers in Mexico City.
inj_report.long: Reichard failed to get the Vikings on the board in the first quarter after his 55-yard field-goal attempt missed to the left. He had the stadium's altitude in his favor when lining up for a 71-yarder on the final play of the first half, but what would have been an NFL record-breaking kick fell just short. Reichard is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts through 10 regular-season games, and each of those misses have come from 50-plus yards. The Vikings will be home in a controlled environment for three of their next four games, starting in Week 12 against the Falcons on Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Boswell went 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts and made his lone PAT in Sunday's 19-16 loss to the Eagles.
inj_report.long: This was a battle of Pennsylvania's kickers, as Boswell and Jake Elliott combined to account for 23 of the game's 35 points. Boswell was good from 25, 40 and 52 yards. The veteran kicker has been trending downward the last two seasons, and he entered play Sunday having made just 79.2 percent of his field-goal tries this season. After his perfect showing against the Eagles, Boswell has made all of his field goals in back-to-back games for the first time all season. On the year, he's 22-for-27 on FGAs and a perfect 18-for-18 on PATs.

inj_report.long: Smack pushed a 53-yard field-goal try wide right in the first quarter before later converting a 40-yard attempt in the final seconds of the third quarter. The rookie has now gone 15-for-21 on field-goal tries, including 3-for-4 from 50-plus yards, while making 21 of 24 extra-point attempts over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

inj_report.short: Smyth made two of three field-goal attempts and his lone PAT in Sunday's 21-13 loss to the Bears.
inj_report.long: The Saints didn't have a scoring drive until the second quarter, when Smyth made his season-long, 56-yard field goal to cut the lead going into halftime, his first of two 50-plus-yard FGs in the game. The 25-year-old also continued his perfect PAT percentage for the season, making his singular attempt (5-for-5 in three games). His play on kickoffs stood out Sunday, committing two penalties for kicking the ball out of bounds and giving Chicago excellent field position.

inj_report.short: Lutz made his lone field-goal attempt and all five PATs in Sunday's 38-24 win over the Raiders.
inj_report.long: The veteran kicker now has gone five straight games without missing a kick, as he's 9-for-9 on field goals and 14-for-14 on extra points in that span. With the Denver offense heating up after a slow start to the campaign, Lutz has become useful in fantasy. On the season, he's 17-for-20 on FGAs and has made all 21 of his PATs.

inj_report.short: Pineiro made all five of his PATs in Sunday night's 35-10 win over the Vikings.
inj_report.long: It was the veteran kicker's third game this season that he didn't attempt a field goal, but he's now gone three straight games with exactly five extra points. Pineiro now leads the league in both point-after attempts (40) and makes (36), but he's attempted just 11 field goals in a highly efficient San Francisco offense. The lack of field goals certainly keeps him from being a top fantasy kicker.

inj_report.short: Borregales made his sole field-goal attempt and one PAT in the Patriots' 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Borregales made a 33-yard field goal on the first drive of the game. The kicker is now 11-for-13 on field-goal attempts and 24-for-25 on PATs through 10 regular-season games in 2026.

inj_report.short: Slye made all three field-goal attempts and went 3-for-3 on PATs in Sunday's 51-30 loss to the Cowboys.
inj_report.long: The veteran kicker made field goals from 38, 48 and 28 yards in the first half and is in the midst of a career-best season. He's now 18-for-19 on field-goal tries and has made all 17 PATs through 10 games. Kicking in one of the lower-scoring offenses in the league, it still doesn't translate to much fantasy appeal for Slye ahead of next Sunday's road date with the Jaguars.

inj_report.short: Santos made both of his field-goal attempts and went 1-for-2 on extra-point tries during the Bears' 21-13 win over the Saints on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Santos got the Bears on the board with a 41-yard field goal in the first quarter before connecting on a 35-yarder in the third. His second point-after try in the second quarter missed to the right, and it was the first missed PAT of the 2026 season for the veteran kicker. Santos' 29 extra points are tied for sixth most in the NFL, and he's 17-for-21 on field-goal attempts (including 3-for-5 on tries from 50-plus yards) through 10 regular-season games. Operating on a short week, the Bears will hit the road for Thanksgiving Day against the Lions.

inj_report.short: Bass went 4-for-5 on field-goal tries and made both of his PATs during Sunday's 26-9 win over the Dolphins.
inj_report.long: Bass was able to make at least three field goals for the fifth time in the team's last six contests. The kicker made field goals from 43 and 54 yards in the first half before adding makes from 40 and 28 yards in the fourth quarter. His lone miss of the day came in the third quarter, when he pulled a 54-yard try wide left, registering his first missed field-goal try of the year. Bass has now gone 24-for-25 on field-goal attempts, including 4-for-5 from 50-plus yards, over 10 contests so far during the 2026 campaign.

inj_report.short: Fairbairn made his sole field-goal attempt and all three PATs in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday night.
inj_report.long: Fairbairn's only field goal of the night was a 27-yarder with 15 seconds remaining in the first half. The kicker is 20-for-21 on field-goal attempts and 27-for-27 on PATs over 10 regular-season games so far in 2026.

inj_report.short: Myers missed his sole field-goal attempt and made three PATs in the Seahawks' 21-13 win over the Raiders on Sunday.
inj_report.long: Myers missed a 44-yard field-goal attempt with 7:05 remaining in the game that would have put the Seahawks up 14 points. The kicker is now 16-for-19 on field-goal attempts and 21-for-23 on PATs over 10 regular-season contests in 2026.

inj_report.short: Bates made one of two field-goal attempts and all four PATs in Sunday's 31-21 win over the Bucs.
inj_report.long: The kicker missed a 53-yard try on the Lions' opening drive of the game but later came back to make one from 56 yards in the second quarter. Through 10 games this season, Bates is 17-for-19 on field-goal attempts and a perfect 33-for-33 on extra points. Bates led the league in PATs in the 2024 and 2025 seasons and is again on pace to kick 50-plus extra points in 2026.

inj_report.short: Carlson reverted to the Dolphins' practice squad Monday, per the NFL's transaction log.
inj_report.long: Carlson was signed to the Dolphins' practice squad this past Tuesday, two weeks after being released by the Saints. He served as the Dolphins' kicker Sunday against the Bills, when he made all three of his field-goal attempts in a 27-9 loss for Miami. The Dolphins do not have a kicker on the 53-man roster, so Carlson is almost certain to be elevated for Week 12 against the Jets on Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: McManus made both of his field-goal attempts and all four PATs in the Rams' 34-6 win over the Cardinals on Sunday.
inj_report.long: McManus' Sunday performance extends his perfect streak with a Rams' special teams unit that desperately needed consistency at kicker. He's now 5-for-5 on field-goal attempts and 14-for-14 on PATs after five regular-season contests as a Ram in 2026.

inj_report.short: Shrader went 1-for-3 on field-goal attempts during the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.
inj_report.long: Shrader opened Thursday's scoring with a 34-yard field goal early in the first quarter. Those ended up being the only three points scored by the Colts, as Shrader missed a 56-yarder later in the quarter, and his 62-yarder in the second quarter was blocked by Logan Hall. It was the second time this season that Shrader has missed two kicks, and the third-year kicker now is 24-for-28 on field-goal attempts (including 9-for-12 on kicks from 50-plus yards) and 19-for-20 on extra-point tries through 11 regular-season games. His scoring potential figures to be lower for the rest of the season after the Colts waived Daniel Jones on Friday, which paves the way for Anthony Richardson to start under center in Week 12 against the Giants on Sunday, Nov. 29.

inj_report.short: Patterson made his only field-goal attempt and went 4-for-4 on extra-point tries during Sunday's 35-33 loss to the Panthers.
inj_report.long: Patterson was able to convert his only field-goal try in Week 11, nailing a chip-shot 28-yard attempt in the first quarter. Patterson has now combined to go 3-for-3 on field-goal attempts while making all six of his PATs over two contests as the starting kicker for Baltimore, and he will likely remain in that role for Week 12 with Tyler Loop (groin) sidelined for at least one more contest.
